correspondences.notes: BIDS 1.11.2 has no derivative suffix for generic or statistical maps (BEP041 pending).

brainlife.desc: Directory of NIfTI maps with arbitrary values (statistical z/F maps, atlas eccentricity maps); value type set by datatype tags.
brainlife.name: neuro/maps

original.desc: (experimental) similar to neuro/rois, this datatype contains any number of nifti files in a directory. Unlike neuro/rois, each nifti can contain any value (not just 0 or 1). The type of values that it contains are determined by datatype tags.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Holding sets of continuous-valued volumes such as GLM statistical maps or atlas maps.

**Not for:** Binary ROI analysis; use neuro/rois. Interpreting values without the datatype tags.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 2 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.maps.json

identifying_risks: Participant-level task maps can reveal individual responses
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Share with participant codes only, inside a controlled project
tier_conditions: Tier 4 when maps form cognitive or behavioural profiles of a person
Tier 1 when averaged across enough participants that no individual can be singled out
